markets.name: 1X2 - Goal Up
markets.info: You have to predict if home/away will win or lead by N goals, or if the match will end with a draw.

markets.name: 1X2
markets.info: You have to predict the final outcome of the match. The bet offers three possible outcomes: 1 (home team wins the match); X (teams draw), 2 (away team wins the match).

markets.name: Correct Score
markets.info: You have to predict the correct score of the entire match.

markets.name: Goal/No Goal
markets.info: You have to predict if the two teams will score at least one goal each during the match. The bet offers two possible outcomes: GG (both teams will score at least one goal during the match); NG (one or none of the two teams will score at least one goal during the match).

markets.name: Double Chance
markets.info: You have to predict the outcome of the entire match. There are 3 possible outcomes: 1X (at the end of the match the home team wins or draws), X2 (at the end of the match the away team wins or draws), 12 (at the end of the match the home team wins or the away team wins).

markets.name: Over/Under
markets.info: You have to predict if the total number of goals scored during the entire match will be over or under the spread indicated.

markets.name: Home Over/Under
markets.info: Predict if the total number of goals scored during the entire match by the home team only will be over or under the spread indicated.

markets.name: Away Over/Under
markets.info: Predict if the total number of goals scored during the entire match by the away team only will be over or under the spread indicated.

markets.name: 1X2 + Over/Under
markets.info: You have to predict the final outcome of the match:  1 (home team wins the match) or X (teams draw) or 2 (away team wins the match) and also predicting whether the total number of goals scored during the entire match will be over or under the spread indicated.

markets.name: Multigoal
markets.info: You have to predict if the total number of goals scored is within a given range.

markets.name: DC + Over/Under
markets.info: You have to predict the outcome of the entire match among 3 possible outcomes: 1X (at the end of the match the home team wins or draws), X2 (at the end of the match the away team wins or draws), 12 (at the end of the match the home team wins or the away team wins) and also predict whether the total number of goals scored during the entire match will be over or under the spread indicated.

markets.name: Multigoal Home
markets.info: You have to predict if the total number of goals scored by the home team is within a given range.

markets.name: Multigoal Away
markets.info: You have to predict if the total number of goals scored by the away team is within a given range.

markets.name: 1X2 + Goal/No Goal
markets.info: You have to predict the final outcome of the match and if the two teams will score at least one goal each during the match.

markets.name: DC + Goal/No Goal
markets.info: You have to predict the outcome of the entire match among 3 possible outcomes: 1X (at the end of the match the home team wins or draws), X2 (at the end of the match the away team wins or draws), 12 (at the end of the match the home team wins or the away team wins) and  predict if the two teams will score at least one goal each during the match which offers two possible outcomes: GG (both teams will score at least one goal during the match); NG (one or none of the two teams will score at least one goal during the match).

roundSpecialMarkets.name: Goals
roundSpecialMarkets.info: Predict the exact number of goals scored across all 10 games

roundSpecialMarkets.name: Goal Bands
roundSpecialMarkets.info: Predict a range for the total number of goals scored in all 10 games

roundSpecialMarkets.name: Draws
roundSpecialMarkets.info: Predict the exact number of draw matches in the round of 10 games

roundSpecialMarkets.name: Draw Bands
roundSpecialMarkets.info: Predict a range for the total number of draws occurring across all 10 games
